title: Honey Mustard Chicken
description: Chicken baked on a bed of softened onion and garlic under a two-mustard honey sauce, with rosemary tucked around. Covered first to cook through, then uncovered and basted to brown.

steps.heading: Make the Sauce
steps.text: In a small bowl, combine both mustards, the honey and 2 tsp of the olive oil.

steps.heading: Soften the Aromatics
steps.text: Heat the remaining 1 tsp oil in an oven-safe braiser or cast-iron skillet over medium heat. Sauté the onion until golden and tender, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook 1 to 2 minutes more, until fragrant.

steps.heading: Assemble
steps.text: Lay the chicken on top of the onion and garlic (if your pan isn't oven-safe, move everything to a baking dish first). Season the tops with salt and pepper, pour the honey mustard over, and tuck the rosemary sprigs around the chicken.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Bake covered at 400°F for 20 minutes. Uncover, baste the chicken with the sauce, and bake 20 to 30 minutes more, until browned on top and cooked through.
